svg.title: Summation error by order
svg.desc: Dot plot of summation error: the in-order sequential sum is furthest from the exact value, lane-split SIMD orders are closer, pairwise, numpy.sum and Kahan are within an ulp.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vectorizing a float sum changes its answer — usually for the better
